_: DeckStreak's hand-proved mutation rows (SPEC-039 R8, ADR-057 D5), in the mutation-rows pack's shape.
This file is the header alone; its tables stay empty. Each SPEC's rows live in its own band
fragment, scripts/mutation-rows.d/S<NNN>00-S<NNN>99.json: SPEC-NNN owns S<NNN>00 to S<NNN>99.
A row is an id S<n>-<NAME>, its target, a find that occurs exactly once in the target, one
replacement, a killer that names exactly one test, and the behaviour the mutant removes.
A cargo killer is <target>::<test path>: an integration-test target of the killer's crate
(crates/<crate>/tests/<target>.rs), or lib for its unit tests, then the test's path in it.
A script killer is <module>.<Class>.<method>, a unittest id in scripts/tests or tools/parity-oracle.
Prove a row with python3 scripts/mutation_rows.py prove --row <id>, on a committed tree.
A row leaves only with its target, or with the maintainer's approval in scripts/mutation-rows.retired.json.
target spelling: MUTATIONS is crate-relative, crates/{cell 1}/{cell 2}
